### Prerequisites
Remote control configuration:
- Available remote control, normal display screen
- Available SIM card, 4G antenna

WEB configuration:
- Matching network port adapter, network cable and computer in the same LAN, computer
- Or the device has WiFi and is connected to the same LAN, computer
- Available SIM card, 4G antenna

### Note:
- IMEI is the International Mobile Equipment Identity, that is, the identification code of the wireless module.
- ICCID is the integrated circuit card identification code, that is, the SIM card number.
- Note: After the SIM card is inserted into the device, the device lock needs to be in the locked state.

### Operation steps
#### Use the remote control display menu configuration
1. Connect the device to the display, insert the SIM card, and power on.
2. Use the remote control to press LOGIN![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=fa1f1539feacffd4cda05aa3729322ad) and DOT![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d20d71d418f24a044261bccfeacc02ac) at the same time button, the display screen will enter the test status display page, as shown below:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=888a92d2f5c74a25c8500e723d4d523e)
Note: Currently the display screen does not support the acquisition and viewing of ICCID information.

#### View using device Web information
1. Connect the device using a wired or WIFI network
2. Use a browser to log in to the WEB system of the device IP. For example, if the device IP is 192.168.1.173, enter http://192.168.1.173 in the browser address bar. Default password: Adm_123
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=bb854fcecd5913c87c7ba9d7e375c9bb)

3. Enter General Settings, click System Information, and click GNet Module Information Check the IMEI number and ICCID of the current device
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=722e28b0b61b5ee05df63fd65b6185c7)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d80bc15059017a8d183d2e60bea74d58)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8355948264043c011376e3f0521e61f3)
Note: To obtain the above information, you need to insert a SIM card. If the device is still dialing, the above information needs to be updated by manually refreshing the web page.
